items.caption: Get ready for a full week of career opportunities with ASME at Ohio State! Join us September 21–28 for Company Info Sessions featuring ExxonMobil, RTX, LyondellBasell, Caterpillar, TSMC, and HRST. Meet engineers and recruiters, learn about internship and full-time opportunities, and make valuable industry connections. All events will be held in Scott Lab, with times and rooms varying by event. Check our individual posts for full details. Bring your resume, come with questions, and get ready to connect! CareerFair Internships
